# Google Ads Freelancer (googleadsfreelancer.com)

> Diego Zietek, independent Google Ads and paid media consultant with 14+ years of hands-on work. Runs Google Ads, with Meta, Microsoft Advertising and LinkedIn when they fit, personally, for a flat monthly fee. Accounts stay in the client's name. Based in Curitiba, Brazil; works remotely in English.

- Market: businesses in the United States and Canada; the UK practice is at ppcconsultancy.uk.
- Services: Google Ads management, audits, setup, conversion tracking, consulting, and multi-platform PPC management.
- Fees: a flat monthly fee, never a percentage of ad spend. No long contract.
- Pricing: quoted per account from the form; prices are not published.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/): Senior Google Ads freelancer, one person on the account.
- [Google Ads management](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-management/): Month-to-month management by the person you hired. Flat fee.
- [Google Ads audit](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-audit/): Fixed-price PPC audit with fixes ranked by impact. Yours to keep.
- [Freelance PPC consultant](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/freelance-ppc-consultant/): Independent PPC management for UK, Irish and North American companies.
- [Google Ads consultant](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/google-ads-consultant/): Strategy, second opinions and advisory for teams that run their own ads.
- [Pricing](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/pricing/): What Google Ads freelancers and consultants charge, and how I price.
- [Results](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/results/): Published engagements, with what can and cannot be verified.
- [About Diego](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/about/): Who runs the account, where from, and what is public.
- [Contact](https://googleadsfreelancer.com/contact/): Send the form or an email. Both reach the same person.
